page.title: Administration
page.subtitle: Accounts, private networks and the record of what administrators did on this instance.
page.noAccess: Only administrators of the instance can open this page.

disable.title: Disable {{email}}?
disable.body: They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until you enable the account again. Their sites and files are kept.

reset.title: Remove the second step of {{email}}?
reset.body: Use this when they lost their device and their recovery codes. Their authenticator app, passkeys and recovery codes are deleted, and the password alone signs them in until they turn it on again. Make sure it is really them: the action is recorded.

networks.intro: Sites can always reach public addresses. Servers in private networks, such as an office or a home lab, work only when their network is listed here or was set when the server started.
networks.fixedNote: From TRANSFERLY_ALLOWED_NETWORKS. Only a restart changes them.
networks.help: One address or network per line, such as 192.168.1.0/24 or 10.20.0.5. The change applies to the next connection.
networks.never: Never allowed: link-local and cloud metadata addresses (169.254.0.0/16), multicast and reserved ranges, and networks wider than /8 (IPv4) or /7 (IPv6).
networks.saved: Saved. New connections follow the change.

actions.limitsChanged: changed the limits of the instance

errors.own_account: You cannot change your own account here.
errors.last_admin: This is the last active administrator. Make somebody else an administrator first.
errors.invalid_network: One of the entries is not a network that can be allowed. Check the addresses and the note below.
errors.too_many_networks: There are too many entries. The limit is 100.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.invalid_limits: A limit is not valid. Use whole numbers, or decimals for MiB/s and GiB, and nothing below zero.

limits.intro: Leave a field empty for no limit. Changes apply to the next request or chunk of data; transfers that are already running keep running. They are kept when the server restarts.
limits.saved: Saved. The limits are in force now.

bandwidth.title: Bandwidth
bandwidth.note: How fast data may move. Transfers slow down together to stay under the caps.

transfers.title: Transfers at once
transfers.note: How many transfers run together. The rest wait in the queue.

quotas.title: Quotas
quotas.note: What accounts may have or move. Existing sites, teams and members are kept when a quota is lowered.

fields.maxMembersPerTeam: Members per team, with waiting invitations
